0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-0), who are unbeaten, riding a six-game winning streak, and 1st in the West, while New Orleans is 0-2 on the road and 11th in the West. The Pelicans are without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Dejounte Murray is day-to-day for a personal reason and a game-time decision. Memphis has Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though they split 2-2 in 2025-26 and New Orleans won their last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
